en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1751 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked, "Which charity is the best?" Imam (as) replied:
"The charity given by one in hardship. Have you not heard the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious:
'And they give preference over themselves, even though they are in need.'
Do you see any surplus here?"
